findings.title: Repeated Circular Responses on Facebook Connection Issue
findings.description: The chatbot repeatedly responded with near-identical messages about the Facebook page not being connected and instructing to create a support ticket, despite the user clearly stating that support tickets are not configured. This caused user frustration and a perception of going in circles, harming user experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement state tracking to avoid repeating the same canned response about connection and support tickets when the user has already indicated those are ineffective. Instead, provide new troubleshooting steps or escalate appropriately.

findings.title: Support Ticket Creation Not Configured but No Alternative Escalation Provided
findings.description: The chatbot informed the user that support ticket creation is not configured and failed to offer a clear alternative escalation path or guidance on how to get human support outside the system. This leaves the user stuck without a clear resolution path for a critical issue.
findings.suggestedFix: When support tickets are not configured, proactively suggest alternative support channels (e.g., email, phone, or external help center) or provide clear instructions on how to escalate issues manually.

findings.title: Overly Long and Detailed Final Response
findings.description: The chatbot's final response (Turn 5) was quite lengthy and dense, which may overwhelm the user given their expressed frustration and need for concise, operational answers.
findings.suggestedFix: Break down complex responses into smaller, actionable chunks or offer to provide details step-by-step upon user request to maintain conciseness and clarity.

findings.title: No Direct Confirmation or Clarification Asked Before Offering Bulk Post Draft Creation
findings.description: The chatbot offered to create bulk post drafts or recurring schedules without first explicitly asking for all required details (targets, cadence, copy) before proposing the action, which is against the golden rule to ask for missing fields before workspace write actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Before offering to create drafts or schedules, explicitly ask the user to provide all necessary details to avoid premature or incomplete workspace write attempts.

findings.title: Repeated identical responses without addressing user confusion
findings.description: The chatbot repeatedly gave the same generic response about clicking the magic link, connecting platforms, and creating profiles across multiple turns without tailoring answers to the user's evolving questions or clarifying how to check login status or find the Platforms section. This caused a frustrating loop that failed to progress the conversation or resolve the user's confusion.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement dynamic response generation that references prior user input and provides step-by-step guidance or asks clarifying questions. Avoid repeating the same canned message multiple times; instead, escalate or offer actionable next steps after repeated confusion.

findings.title: Failed to provide operational, step-by-step instructions as requested
findings.description: Despite the user explicitly requesting a step-by-step walkthrough to check login status, locate the Platforms section, connect TikTok, and set up a profile, the chatbot never provided concrete, actionable instructions or navigation guidance. This violates the product requirement for concise and operational answers and leaves a novice user stranded.
findings.suggestedFix: Enhance the chatbot to provide clear, sequential instructions tailored to the user's context, such as: 'To check if you are logged in, look for your username in the top right corner of the dashboard. To find Platforms, click the sidebar menu labeled Platforms. To connect TikTok, click Add Platform and select TikTok.'

findings.title: Overly verbose and technical response not suited for novice user
findings.description: The chatbot's responses include technical details and commands (e.g., `/support from_user_triage | Connection not saved | platform, page, expected success, actual missing state |`) that are unlikely to be understood or actionable by a low-tech, novice user. This adds confusion rather than clarity.
findings.suggestedFix: Simplify language and avoid exposing raw command syntax unless the user explicitly requests advanced troubleshooting. Instead, offer to create a support ticket or escalate with a simple explanation.
